family_rule.text: sort the synth_ood family names by sha256(f"20261109:v05c-family:{name}").hexdigest() and take the first 6 (seen: the OOD disclosure draws only from them); the other 4 are unseen

note: repo only; never handed to the weight author

retime.applies_to: every synth_ood session Phase C generates (the OOD disclosure's candidates and the held-out OOD set); not the in-distribution set, val or the original disclosure
retime.text: synth_ood starts every session's clock at 2026-03-14T00:00:00+00:00 (the standard generator starts at a random day and second of the day), so every timestamp of an OOD session, in its canonical events and its raw ops alike, is shifted by the session's offset before it is rendered or written; event order, gaps, every other field and the oracle record are unchanged (phase_c_data.retime_session)

selection: v03.scoring.disclosure_selection (by import): gate passed, scored oracle label, 50 per class in class order, ascending key, at most one window per session
